svg.title: Initial masking and matched cover events in a revocation status list
svg.desc: A twelve-position experimental status transcript illustrates initial masks, a genuine event and a matched cover event. Operator-held allocation and mask state are separated from credential-recipient fields and per-credential checks. Known active initialization reveals the fixed masks; membership protection requires matched complete histories and stated side information. Source: Dr. Carsten Stöcker / Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

g.aria-label: Initial masking and matched cover events
Experimental profile • Twelve illustrative positions • Irreversible status
Only the relevant per-entry fields are disclosed in the credential
The illustrated times show encoding mechanics, not evidence that event laws match.
Zeros reveal initial semantic state, not the genuine versus decoy allocation.
Unknown-membership protection requires matched complete histories and stated side information.
